title: Assertion: Legal FSM Transitions
constraints: The monitored FSM has states IDLE = 0, REQ = 1, XFER = 2, DONE = 3. Legal next states: IDLE → {IDLE, REQ}; REQ → {REQ, XFER, IDLE}; XFER → {DONE}; DONE → {DONE, IDLE}.
Fire on any other transition. Staying in XFER for more than one cycle is illegal too.
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: `inside` keeps the others short: `state == 2'd0 |=> state inside {2'd0, 2'd1}`.
A transition-coverage checker in a real flow would also record which of these arcs were exercised.
